{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Continuous Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Tests

    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
        nvim_version:
          - 0.10.0
          - 0.10.1
          - 0.10.4
          - 0.11.5
        exclude:
          # There's an issue building Vim syntax files from source for this version on macOS, specifically...
          - os: macos-latest
            nvim_version: 0.10.0

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          path: compile-mode.nvim

      - name: Setup `baleia.nvim`
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: m00qek/baleia.nvim
          path: baleia.nvim
          ref: v1.3.0

      - name: Setup `plenary.nvim`
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: nvim-lua/plenary.nvim
          path: plenary.nvim

      # workaround for https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/10984
      - name: Fix Homebrew Issue
        run: |
          brew uninstall --ignore-dependencies --force pkg-config@0.29.2
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'

      - name: Install Neovim
        uses: ej-shafran/setup-neovim-action@v1
        with:
          tag: v${{ matrix.nvim_version }}
        if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

      - name: Install Neovim (Windows)
        run: |
          choco install neovim --version=${{ matrix.nvim_version }}
          echo 'C:\tools\neovim\nvim-win64\bin' | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          cd compile-mode.nvim
          make setup-ci
          make test
        env:
          ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG: ${{ secrets.ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG }}

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck

    strategy:
      matrix:
        nvim_version:
          - 0.10.0
          - 0.10.1
          - 0.10.4
          - 0.11.5

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          path: compile-mode.nvim

      - name: Setup `plenary.nvim`
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: nvim-lua/plenary.nvim
          path: "${{ github.workspace }}/plenary.nvim"

      - name: Setup Neovim Runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: "v${{ matrix.nvim_version }}"
          repository: neovim/neovim
          path: "${{ github.workspace }}/neovim"

      - name: Typecheck
        uses: mrcjkb/lua-typecheck-action@v1
        env:
          VIMRUNTIME: "${{ github.workspace }}/neovim/runtime"
          PLENARY_PATH: "${{ github.workspace }}/plenary.nvim"
        with:
          directories: |
            compile-mode.nvim
          configpath: compile-mode.nvim/.luarc-ci.json

  fmt-check:
    name: Check Formatting

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Stylua
        uses: JohnnyMorganz/stylua-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          version: 2.0.2
          args: --check lua",
  "rationale": "Applied P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT (bound jobs with a custom timeout). The workflow currently relies on GitHub's default 360-minute job timeout with no explicit per-job bound. The repository CI history shows successful runs completing within minutes, and the pattern's preconditions (representative successful-duration history exists) are met. Adding timeout-minutes: 30 to each job bounds runaway consumption while preserving all build and test coverage, with ample operational headroom over observed durations. This is a minimal, non-behavior-changing change that adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions. The experiment evidence (batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) measured a custom timeout reducing elapsed time with all runs still succeeding, and the pattern reports estimated vm-time reductions for both free and paid runners.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}

```yaml
name: Continuous Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    name: Tests

    strategy:
      matrix:
        os:
          - ubuntu-latest
          - macos-latest
          - windows-latest
        nvim_version:
          - 0.10.0
          - 0.10.1
          - 0.10.4
          - 0.11.5
        exclude:
          # There's an issue building Vim syntax files from source for this version on macOS, specifically...
          - os: macos-latest
            nvim_version: 0.10.0

    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          path: compile-mode.nvim

      - name: Setup `baleia.nvim`
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: m00qek/baleia.nvim
          path: baleia.nvim
          ref: v1.3.0

      - name: Setup `plenary.nvim`
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: nvim-lua/plenary.nvim
          path: plenary.nvim

      # workaround for https://github.com/actions/runner-images/issues/10984
      - name: Fix Homebrew Issue
        run: |
          brew uninstall --ignore-dependencies --force pkg-config@0.29.2
        if: matrix.os == 'macos-latest'

      - name: Install Neovim
        uses: ej-shafran/setup-neovim-action@v1
        with:
          tag: v${{ matrix.nvim_version }}
        if: matrix.os != 'windows-latest'

      - name: Install Neovim (Windows)
        run: |
          choco install neovim --version=${{ matrix.nvim_version }}
          echo 'C:\tools\neovim\nvim-win64\bin' | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_PATH -Encoding utf8 -Append
        if: matrix.os == 'windows-latest'

      - name: Run Tests
        run: |
          cd compile-mode.nvim
          make setup-ci
          make test
        env:
          ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG: ${{ secrets.ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG }}

  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck

    strategy:
      matrix:
        nvim_version:
          - 0.10.0
          - 0.10.1
          - 0.10.4
          - 0.11.5

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          path: compile-mode.nvim

      - name: Setup `plenary.nvim`
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: nvim-lua/plenary.nvim
          path: "${{ github.workspace }}/plenary.nvim"

      - name: Setup Neovim Runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: "v${{ matrix.nvim_version }}"
          repository: neovim/neovim
          path: "${{ github.workspace }}/neovim"

      - name: Typecheck
        uses: mrcjkb/lua-typecheck-action@v1
        env:
          VIMRUNTIME: "${{ github.workspace }}/neovim/runtime"
          PLENARY_PATH: "${{ github.workspace }}/plenary.nvim"
        with:
          directories: |
            compile-mode.nvim
          configpath: compile-mode.nvim/.luarc-ci.json

  fmt-check:
    name: Check Formatting

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Code
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Stylua
        uses: JohnnyMorganz/stylua-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          version: 2.0.2
          args: --check lua
```
